verdict.rationale: Databricks documents its own ingestion connectors: an ingestion page for choosing a standard connector by data source, and managed connectors alongside SQL/Spark APIs. It also has partner documentation for dbt (an ELT/transformation tool) covering install and connection. However, the evidence never names which SaaS apps or databases the connectors cover, and dbt is the only partner ETL/ELT tool shown with setup docs. Missing for 10: explicit list of SaaS-app connectors, explicit database connectors (e.g., CDC from operational DBs), documented setup steps for managed connectors, partner ingestion tools beyond dbt, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a data-engineer, first-party and partner connectors cover my sources — SaaS apps, databases, and ETL/ELT tools — with documented setup
